scope: Read-only visual and provenance audit of the configured studio templates and static/default studio section image references, before remediation. No live Shopify media settings were queried.
methods: Parsed index.json and all ten page.studio-*.json templates; inventoried configured block image filenames.
Inventoried hardcoded/default image asset references across studio sections.
Visually reviewed all 77 asset filenames through four contact sheets, plus detailed source and crop inspections.
Cross-checked all 13 recovered original artist references against retained templates/page.artist-portfolio.json and its author_name fields.
Checked four retained work images against the correct artist heading in the archived public portfolio.
Compared all 21 product image/title assignments with docs/studio-catalog-mapping.json; all 21 product and 27 roulette output hashes matched the recorded source mapping.
Simulated documented CSS cover crops for gallery, service and detailed artist images. No browser interaction was performed.

findings.title: Whitening service shows the artist instead of the service
findings.detail: The photograph is Megan seated indoors, not teeth whitening or a whitening treatment. It remains valid for her artist and booking profile.
findings.recommendation: Replace only the whitening service image with an authentic whitening image; preserve Megan's profile uses.
findings.action_taken: Homepage, services page, and preset now use the native1270x1081 whitening comparison from Megan; her portrait remains on artist/booking profiles.

findings.title: Two contextual photos are selectable as tattoo designs
findings.detail: Image 22 is the complete numbered flash board; image 25 is the rules sign. Both are currently included in the random pool and described as individual numbered designs.
findings.recommendation: Remove these two blocks from both wheel pools, leaving 25 actual design photographs. Remove them from the single-design gallery or preserve them separately with explicit board/rules captions. Keep the different sp-source-flash-wall.webp photograph in the Welcome gallery and flash feature.
findings.action_taken: Board and rules images removed from both wheel pools and single-design gallery;25 actual design photographs remain. Archived context images and the separate Welcome flash-wall image are preserved.

findings.title: Imported gallery order is presented as physical design numbering
findings.detail: The #1 through #27 titles were generated from import order. sp-roulette-11.webp visibly carries handwritten 15. The roulette board photo and the Welcome board photo each carry their own 1 through 18 sets with different designs. No verified one-to-one mapping between all 27 photographs and physical wheel numbers was found.
findings.recommendation: Use descriptive captions from roulette_inventory rather than claims about physical design numbers. Keep the online wheel explicitly an inspiration browser.
findings.action_taken: All selectable roulette images have reviewed descriptive captions. Wheel status identifies collection-photo position, not an official physical design number.

findings.title: Fixed cover crops remove parts of the work or working context
findings.detail: The gallery's 4:5 cover crop cuts the outside legs of both spiders and the outer strokes of Rigo's lettering. The detailed-artist 4:3 crop at center 30% removes Jake's gloved hands and the bottom of Rigo's floral composition.
findings.recommendation: Use full-frame contain or asset-specific fitting for these cases. Preserve lightbox access to full originals. The tattoo, piercing and tooth-gem service crops keep their main subjects visible.
findings.action_taken: Full-image fitting for the spider pair and Rigo lettering in work grids; Jake, Rigo, and Sonny artist cards retain full original frames. Studio editor includes per-image framing controls.

findings.title: Five aftercare photographs were inherited from generated-source files
findings.detail: All five map to original current-site files named ChatGPT-Image-Mar-24-2026-*.png. They visually depict composed product scenes rather than the genuine studio photography used elsewhere. This is inherited source imagery, not newly generated by this redesign.
findings.recommendation: Replace with verified real product photography when available. Do not silently claim these are authentic camera photographs or invent packaging details.
findings.action_taken: Three official manufacturer images replace the inherited mockups after comparison with product-specific client source images. Repair gel and Enhance balm keep their catalog information in image-free text cards pending exact package-size/photo confirmation.

findings.title: Two artist cards deliberately show work samples, not portraits
findings.detail: The retained Shopify profile_image fields for Rigo and Sonny already point to their floral tattoo and ear-jewelry photographs. Current alt text accurately describes the work. No incorrect artist assignment was found. Sonny's source is only 461x461 and Megan's portrait is 480x481.
findings.recommendation: Retain truthful work-image descriptions and optionally label them as work by the artist. Obtain verified portraits for a consistent team presentation; do not substitute an unrelated person.
findings.action_taken: Rigo and Sonny work images remain correctly attributed and truthfully described. No unrelated portraits were substituted.

validated_groups.hero: Storefront opening, Sonny heart-ear jewelry for piercings, and Jake at work for tattoos match their roles. The storefront with the word artists is studio context rather than an artist portrait.
validated_groups.welcome_story_visit: Storefront, Jake working, and the physical flash wall match captions. sp-source-storefront.webp and sp-storefront.webp are byte-identical aliases.
validated_groups.artists: All four assignments match retained named Shopify profile references. Rigo and Sonny show work, not headshots.
validated_groups.services: Tattoo, piercing and tooth-gem assignments match. Whitening portrait needs replacement.
validated_groups.social: All six work images and artist profile links match attribution. They are curated images, not verified individual Instagram post permalinks.
validated_groups.portfolio: All 14 unique work images match visible subject and named artist provenance; framing corrections noted above.
validated_groups.flash: All six current captions match the visible sheet themes.
validated_groups.products: All 21 static fallback product image/title assignments match the archived catalog; no cross-product swap found. Five generated-source aftercare images need quality review. Several clothing images show only the printed artwork, so sleeve length or garment cut cannot be independently verified visually.
validated_groups.roulette: Twenty-five tattoo/design images plus a board and a rules sign. No complete physical-number mapping verified.
validated_groups.support: Original crest logo, event poster, and legacy background artwork match their decorative or contextual roles.

limitations: This audits the committed template/default asset configuration, not unpublished merchant changes in the Shopify theme editor.
Dynamic Shopify product.featured_image values cannot be verified until actual products are connected. The current template uses static fallback assets.
Catalog/source attribution does not independently verify current inventory, product formulations, physical wheel availability, or artist identity beyond the studio's own labels.
The generated-looking aftercare images have source filenames identifying ChatGPT Image; the original generation/edit workflow itself is unavailable.
